fields.label: Initials: Pastoral care. This is pastoral care from a minister, not licensed mental health treatment, and I may be referred to a licensed professional when needed.

fields.name: past_initial_privilege
fields.label: Initials: Privilege. The clergy-penitent privilege varies by state and does not cover everything.

fields.name: past_initial_harm
fields.label: Initials: Safety. My minister may share information to protect me or someone else from serious harm.

fields.name: past_initial_abuse
fields.label: Initials: Abuse reporting. My minister will report suspected abuse or neglect of a child, an elder, or a dependent adult as the law requires.

fields.name: past_initial_legal
fields.label: Initials: Legal. A court order or other law may require my minister to release information.

fields.name: past_initial_church
fields.label: Initials: Church. Nothing is shared with church leaders, staff, or prayer lists without my permission, and my minister may consult a supervisor without my name.

fields.name: past_initial_electronic
fields.label: Initials: Electronic. Email, text, and video have privacy risks, and I chose my contact methods above.

fields.name: past_initial_technology
fields.label: Initials: Technology. I understand how secure software and AI-assisted tools may be used, and I made my choice above.
